name: Interest Collections
overview: Tag movies and shows with IMDb-style semantic Interests and build collections from them
description: Classifies movies and TV shows using granular semantic "Interests" (Psychological Thriller, Drug Crime, Dark Comedy, Serial Killer, Dystopian Sci-Fi, ...) instead of only coarse genres. Interests are written to Jellyfin Tags and can optionally be materialised as managed Collections, so a single title can appear in many interest-based collections at once.
